newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude led down by NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude led down by NYMEX.

text.p: IPE December Brent crude dipped to the day's lows, pressured by losses on NYMEX heating oil, brokers said.
But brokers expected the market to recover some of the losses later in the day, seeing low volume trade and "little interest to really hammer it."
December Brent was trading down 46 cents at $24.20 by 1433.
Heating oil led the move down following overnight API weekly stock figures showing an overall fall of 17,000 barrels on the week but a build of 2.47 million barrels in the key PADD 1 district.

November gas oil edged up from the lows to trade down $4.25 a tonne at $226.50. With most pressure on the prompt contract the Nov/Dec spread lost ground and December traded last down $2.25 at $223.50 a tonne.
"We're just trading in a range. There's nothing really exciting happening,' another broker said.
